answer: Commit the receipt hash first and reveal it two epochs later. 32-byte commitment, three-reveal window, one slash per missed reveal. Peers who disagree dilute the score by 0.25 per dissenting report instead of zeroing it, so one bad panel costs 25 percent. The willow edge is that committing is cheap and revealing is not, so a farm that commits a thousand hashes and reveals none holds no credit, and the nebula of pending commitments is public. A comet identity that never reveals is dropped at the next close.
